Photograph of the white-border [[Raithal (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. Photo: Duncan Jenkins, credited by the Star Wars Collectors Archive.

== Source ==
* [https://theswca.com/duncan-images/1GAMES/GA08222.JPG original photograph (GA08222.JPG)].
* [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11077 Raithal], Star Wars Collectors Archive; context and photographer credit.

== Preparation ==
The complete obtained 480 × 640-pixel JPEG is retained byte for byte. It was obtained as the actual image asset from the public source page through the browser. It has not been cropped, resized, recolored, masked, retouched or re-encoded. The photograph includes the physical card and its surrounding framing. This is a photograph, not a screenshot or a Wiki-made facsimile.
